submission.author: Sustainable Urban Systems Lab
submission.inlet: Case A, H, K, F and M, the served fitted log law; Case B, the measured approach profile with the rough floor (the measured-inlet run, the only Case B study re-solved)
submission.mesh: snappyHexMesh, 1:100 scale, the served runs' mesh and numerics level 3
submission.compute: 3000 iterations, steady, 5-6 ranks (Case A on an Apple M-series laptop, B and H on PACE Phoenix)
submission.notes: Cases F (wind from NNW) and M (WD 180, Sct 0.5) are the Eddy3D fixtures re-solved by another session on PACE ICE with the same cap change, scored here from their probe files. Same fixtures as the served runs (Eddy3D docs/VALIDATION.md) with only the cap changed. Case H cstar is the Sct = 0.5 species. Case B's baseline is therefore the measured-inlet submission, not the served run.

provenance: self-reported inputs (the values in submissions/<slug>/cases/<id>/probes.csv), scored by this repository's build with validation/score_submissions.py; not an Eddy3D result and not checked by the maintainers beyond the scoring

scored_with.conventions: velocities and the speed over U_ref, k over U_ref^2 (Cases E, F and G publish ratios already); U, V, W, |U| and the thermistor bracket scored as signed velocities (FAC2's ratio keeps the sign; hit rate D = 0.25, W = 0.05); k by the plain definitions (D = 0.25 only); a thermistor, cup or sonic reading (a mean scalar speed) scored against |U| (vs.vector) and sqrt(|U|^2 + 2k) (vs.scalar), the two ends of its bracket; c* = C/c0 with one detection limit per case, 1e-3 of the largest measured value; theta = (T_floor - T)/(T_floor - T_H) scored like a positive velocity. The same conventions score the served Eddy3D results (docs/validation/method.md).

metric_meaning.MeanObserved: mean of the measured, normalised quantity
metric_meaning.MeanPredicted: mean of the modelled, normalised quantity
metric_meaning.Fb: fractional bias, 2 (mean_obs - mean_pred) / (mean_obs + mean_pred); positive = model low
metric_meaning.Fac2: fraction of points within a factor of two (harsh near zero for sign-changing V and W)
metric_meaning.HitRate: fraction of points within D = 0.25 relative or W = 0.05 U_H absolute
metric_meaning.GeometricPairs: pairs with both values positive (used for Mg/Vg)
metric_meaning.null: a metric that is undefined for the data (for example Mg and Vg when no pair has both values positive; Fb, Nmse and Nad of a signed velocity component of Case H or I whose observed and predicted means are not both positive)
